title: Senior Product Manager (Fintech)
description:
Our client, a fintech company with a payments app used in 30 countries, is hiring a Senior Product Manager.

Responsibilities
- Own the payments onboarding funnel and KYC flow.
- Run experiments to raise activation and first-transaction conversion.
- Work with compliance, engineering and design.

Requirements
- 5+ years in product management.
- Experience with conversion funnels and A/B testing.
- Fintech or payments experience is a plus.

Fully remote.
